usedFor: People found by a finished AI for Database run are added as HubSpot contacts.

bestTemplate.name: “New Workflow Run Completed” in AI for Database, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A finished run carries status and results, which is where the list of people comes from.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, and “New Workflow Run Completed” also fires for runs that failed.
